metrics.first_candidate_admission_rate: candidate-0 episodes admitted / candidate-0 episodes sealed (unattempted and attempted-but-unsealed tasks are in neither)
metrics.admission_yield_up_to_two_candidates: tasks with an admitted episode / tasks whose outcome is determined (admitted at candidate 0, or candidate 0 rejected and candidate 1 sealed). Candidate 1 is generated ONLY for a task whose candidate 0 was sealed and rejected: a bounded data-admission retry, not pass@2 (which samples two candidates for every task) and not pass^k
metrics.level_pass_rate: per verifier level and candidate: sealed episodes that passed it / sealed episodes it was checked on (passed + failed); unverified (None) episodes are counted apart, never as passed
metrics.protocol_validity: level protocol: natural termination, the mode's think rule, every tool-call block parsed, V1's tail rule
metrics.schema_validity: level schema_validity: every call names an offered tool and its arguments satisfy its JSON Schema
metrics.gold_tool_call_match: level step_gold: the call set of every gold-carrying turn equals one allowed gold set (name + arguments, canonicalized; order-free) -- exact match against the source's recorded expert call (G2: agreement with a model-generated gold, not human-verified)
metrics.recorded_execution: level recorded_execution: every executed call matched a recorded response of the replay table (recorded-response replay; no executable environment, no final-state check); None when the episode executed no call
metrics.target_tools_called: level target_tools_called: every target tool called at least once (recall; extra or wrong calls unchecked) -- not tool-selection accuracy
metrics.tool_selection: level tool_selection: here only no_call -- no call on any turn of a no-tool task
metrics.verification_coverage: admitted episodes by the exact set of levels they were verified at (True), per source and episode shape
metrics.supervised_tokens: generated token ids of the admitted training/validation episodes' turns (each counted once)
metrics.scored_positions: assistant positions of the admitted calibration/state-evaluation episodes' items

prefill_tokens_per_second.why: the batched engine interleaves prefill and decode; the TTFT distribution and the prompt tokens are reported

priors._: [low, expected, high]; six_category_design.json :: tool_calling.expected_per_arm (A1's teacher evaluation and Thinking-2507's historical tool turns). A pilot's measured values replace them before the cap is final
